title: Warm Spring Egyptian Rice Bake
description: A nutty, springy Egyptian-inspired dish featuring juniper berries, all wrapped in a crispy pastry.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 180 degrees Celsius.
Prepare the pastry dough according to package instructions.
Heat butter in a pan over medium heat.
Add cumin and paprika powder. Cook for 1 minute.
Add jasmine tea and juniper berries. Cook for 1 minute more.
Add milk and bring to a simmer.
Add rice to the pan and stir well to coat rice in spice mixture.
Transfer the rice mixture to a baking dish and smooth the top.
Roll out the pastry dough to fit over the rice mixture and crimp edges to seal.
Place the pastry-topped rice bake in the oven and bake for 40 minutes.
Remove from oven and garnish with fresh parsley.
Let it rest for 10 minutes before serving.
